name: alert_rules_manage
description: CRUD operations for threshold-based alert rules. An alert rule defines a condition on a domain metric (e.g., 'alert if SPY price drops below 400'). Rules persist to disk and are evaluated by alert_check and the sentinel scheduler. Supported operators: gt, lt, gte, lte, eq, ne, contains.

parameters.action: string (required) — One of: create, list, get, update, delete
parameters.rule: object (required) — Rule definition containing: id (string, required), domain (string), metric (string), operator (string), threshold (any), message (string)

examples.description: Create a rule to alert when SPY drops below 400
examples.call: alert_rules_manage({ action: "create", rule: { id: "spy-crash", domain: "markets", metric: "spy_price", operator: "lt", threshold: 400, message: "SPY has dropped below $400" } })
